Andy North seen here representing Surrey in the Junior Inter Counties broke through last winter to finish a highly respectable 20th in the Junior National C.C.Champs and put his excellent winters background to good use by breaking the Club's long standing Junior 5000m record with a fine 14.55.

Like the Curate's egg the Cross Country season was good in parts, initially promising a lot with a win in the South of Thames Junior, but turning out to be a lame effort with only Oliver Foote in the Seniors and Andy North in the Juniors showing impressive improvements with high placings in the National CC Champs.
Oliver Foote was on schedule to lead the individual championship but was on holiday for the last match. Notable improvements from Andy North, Martin Lake and Francis Ward.

Although the 5½ mile course was wet the stoney paths helped the faster track men to a good start and after 2 miles the 250 strong field was led by 4 Belgravians - Oliver Foote, Mark Sinclair, John Gladwin and Dave North, with Andy North and Francis Ward not far behind.

In the Juniors Andy North almost ran up to the form he had displayed in the Surrey league as he finished 5th to get a Surrey vest. Again the Juniors got 4th team and with a bit of luck could have got Silver.
In the Junior race Andy North proved he should have had a Surrey medal as he finished in 55th place with 33.27 to be the second Surrey Junior man home.
In the Juniors Andy North beat Surrey Junior Silver and Bronze medallists to continue his steady improvement. Seniors: 1.N.Braun 2.R.Treadwell 3.A.Bristow.

And as for the Juniors - what can you say of Andy North's run. While others sank to their knees Andy floated across the mud and reminded many of us who were fortunate to see his run of another great North of some 30 years earlier!
